fields.label: Research Desk User
fields.description: Whose release this is. Everyone releases their own corrections; nobody can release another person's.

fields.label: Licence for My Corrections
fields.description: The open licence under which the pages you proofread or validated may be shared as OCR ground truth. CC0: no conditions; CC-BY: credit; CC-BY-SA: credit and share alike. A set can carry your pages only under a licence at least as strict as yours.

fields.label: You May Name Me
fields.description: Put my full name (never my email) in the sets my pages are in, as credit.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Optional: anything you want the library to know about this release.
